raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Customers migrated to the new CRM on 2026-01-15 carry numeric region codes ('01'-'04') instead of region names, so silver_customers and gold_region_daily contain unmapped regions. raw_region_map, which the CRM team supplied, gives the authoritative code-to-name mapping, so silver_customers can translate the codes.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.88, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, upper(COALESCE(m.region_name, c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON trim(c.region) = trim(m.region_code)"}}
